options.name: default_group
options.description: Specifies the name of a RACF-defined group to be used as the default group for the user

options.name: groups
options.description: List of Groups to update connection for the user

options.name: list_only
options.description: When true module will only execute a list to the user

options.name: return_output
options.description: When true will return the ful output of LISTUSER

options.name: segments
options.description: List of segments you would like the module to collect info CICS CSDATA DCE DFP EIM KERB LANGUAGE LNOTES NDS NETVIEW NORACF OMVS OPERPARM OVM PROXY TSO WORKATTR

options.name: state
options.description: This field is required in case list_only is true If `present` checks if user exists if not create If `absent` checks if user exists if so deletes If `connect` it will connect the user with groups specified If `remove` will remove the connection  from user with group

options.name: user_dfp_segment
options.description: Define DFP Segment for the new user

options.name: user_name_info
options.description: Specifies the user name to be associated with the new user ID. You can use a maximum of 20 alphanumeric or non-alphanumeric character

options.name: user_omvs_segment
options.description: Define OMVS Segment for the new user

options.name: user_owner
options.description: Specifies a RACF-defined user or group to be assigned as the owner of the RACF profile for the user being added

options.name: user_password
options.description: Define a password for the new user

options.name: user_tso_segment
options.description: Define TSO Segment for the new user
